response.overview: Four teenagers navigate unrequited love, family ties, and growing up, in these intertwined stories set in Laos. After the death of his father, Tar has to give up everything, including his own education and the girl he loves. Ning is a wealthy girl with no mother and an absentee father. She is lonely until she meets Tar, when her story changes. Korn is a talented dancer living a life of solitude who falls in love with Ning, though she does not reciprocate. Liew is an adopted girl who lives with a family next to Korn's house, and develops feelings for him. However, her story changes after she discovers the truth about herself.
response.title: Big Heart
